### Fixed
- **muster rolls when its OAuth credentials or its Valkey password change.** The pod template carries `checksum/oauth-secret` beside `checksum/config`: the SHA-256 of the chart-rendered `<fullname>-oauth` Secret's data, or the new `muster.oauth.server.existingSecretChecksum` value verbatim when the credentials come from a Secret the chart cannot read, so whoever rotates that Secret changes the mark in the same change (a Flux `HelmRelease` can feed it through `valuesFrom` with `targetPath`); a Valkey password in a Secret of its own is marked by `muster.oauth.server.storage.valkey.existingSecretChecksum` as `checksum/valkey-secret`. Before, muster read the projected Secrets at start and never again, so a rotated Dex client secret, encryption key or Valkey password left the running pod on the old values until a hand-run restart, and muster disagreed with Dex (`invalid_client`) or its Valkey (`WRONGPASS`) as soon as one of them restarted. The Secret template and the annotation render the data from one helper, so the two cannot drift. Chart unit tests pin the annotations. ([#1315](https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/issues/1315))
